original_text: Most people's experience with LLMs and documents looks like RAG: you upload a collection of files, the LLM retrieves relevant chunks at query time, and generates an answer. This works, but the LLM is rediscovering knowledge from scratch on every question. There's no accumulation. Ask a subtle question that requires synthesizing five documents, and the LLM has to find and piece together the relevant fragments every time. Nothing is built up. NotebookLM, ChatGPT file uploads, and most RAG systems work this way.

original_text: The idea here is different. Instead of just retrieving from raw documents at query time, the LLM **incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki** — a structured, interlinked collection of markdown files that sits between you and the raw sources. When you add a new source, the LLM doesn't just index it for later retrieval. It reads it, extracts the key information, and integrates it into the existing wiki — updating entity pages, revising topic summaries, noting where new data contradicts old claims, strengthening or challenging the evolving synthesis. The knowledge is compiled once and then *kept current*, not re-derived on every query.

Obsidian is the IDE; the LLM is the programmer; the wiki is the codebase.

original_text: **Ingest.** You drop a new source into the raw collection and tell the LLM to process it. An example flow: the LLM reads the source, discusses key takeaways with you, writes a summary page in the wiki, updates the index, updates relevant entity and concept pages across the wiki, and appends an entry to the log. A single source might touch 10-15 wiki pages. Personally I prefer to ingest sources one at a time and stay involved — I read the summaries, check the updates, and guide the LLM on what to emphasize. But you could also batch-ingest many sources at once with less supervision. It's up to you to develop the workflow that fits your style and document it in the schema for future sessions.

original_text: At some point you may want to build small tools that help the LLM operate on the wiki more efficiently. A search engine over the wiki pages is the most obvious one — at small scale the index file is enough, but as the wiki grows you want proper search. [qmd](https://github.com/tobi/qmd) is a good option: it's a local search engine for markdown files with hybrid BM25/vector search and LLM re-ranking, all on-device. It has both a CLI (so the LLM can shell out to it) and an MCP server (so the LLM can use it as a native tool). You could also build something simpler yourself — the LLM can help you vibe-code a naive search script as the need arises.

original_text: - **Download images locally.** In Obsidian Settings → Files and links, set "Attachment folder path" to a fixed directory (e.g. `raw/assets/`). Then in Settings → Hotkeys, search for "Download" to find "Download attachments for current file" and bind it to a hotkey (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+D). After clipping an article, hit the hotkey and all images get downloaded to local disk. This is optional but useful — it lets the LLM view and reference images directly instead of relying on URLs that may break. Note that LLMs can't natively read markdown with inline images in one pass — the workaround is to have the LLM read the text first, then view some or all of the referenced images separately to gain additional context. It's a bit clunky but works well enough.

original_text:
我想搭建一个上市公司知识库系统，它具有如下几个模块：
1，数据存储模块，1.1）每个公司有独立的子目录，1.2）每个公司的目录下有1.2.1）原始文档，包括公司的定期财报，招股说明书等重要公告，投资者关系文档 1.2.2）公司的券商研报，新闻文章等 1.2.3）经整理过的按主题分类的公司进展文档，每个文档包含一个主题，内容按时间线把新闻，公告等内容做摘要记录下来 1.3）也要建立行业，主题，板块为单位的子目录 1.4）这些行业，主题，板块的子目录下包括1.4.1）相关的券商研报，新闻文章等，1.4.2）也包括根据之前股票的新闻整理出来的行业或板块信息。举例来说，一家汽车公司的最新公告或投资者关系文档既可以给这个公司的相关主题文档提供新的时间线进展，也可以给汽车行业的相关主题文档提供时间线进展。
2，数据采集模块，2.1）公司的定期财报，招股说明书等重要公告，投资者关系文档等，关于这些我已经有现成的程序，只要适当配置就可以 2.2）新闻，需要用搜索引擎定期查询 2.3）数据采集模块需要定期运行（比如每天或者每周），针对给定的上市公司名单 
3，数据整理模块，对于2里采集的数据，一旦采集后启动数据整理模块，根据事先设定好的主题（通常是对于公司或对应的行业和板块有一系列事先设好的问题）查看最新的信息（公告或新闻）有没有提供对这些问题的更新回答，如果有就要加到公司或行业和板块的对应主题的时间线上。
4，以上知识库系统要有自我进化能力，也要给用户足够的配置选择，包括公司列表，主题对应的问题清单，行业和板块等都可以动态进化。具体实现可以参考llm-wiki.md文档 ，也可以考虑知识库工具比如obsidian cli等等。

original_text:
我想搭建一个上市公司知识库系统，它具有如下几个模块：
1，数据存储模块，1.1）每个公司有独立的子目录，1.2）每个公司的目录下有1.2.1）原始文档，包括公司的定期财报，招股说明书等重要公告，投资者关系文档 1.2.2）公司的券商研报，新闻文章等 1.2.3）经整理过的按主题分类的公司进展文档，每个文档包含一个主题，内容按时间线把新闻，公告等内容做摘要记录下来 1.3）也要建立行业，主题，板块为单位的子目录 1.4）这些行业，主题，板块的子目录下包括1.4.1）相关的券商研报，新闻文章等，1.4.2）也包括根据之前股票的新闻整理出来的行业或板块信息。举例来说，一家汽车公司的最新公告或投资者关系文档既可以给这个公司的相关主题文档提供新的时间线进展，也可以给汽车行业的相关主题文档提供时间线进展。
2，数据采集模块，2.1）公司的定期财报，招股说明书等重要公告，投资者关系文档等，关于这些我已经有现成的程序，只要适当配置就可以 2.2）新闻，需要用搜索引擎定期查询 2.3）数据采集模块需要定期运行（比如每天或者每周），针对给定的上市公司名单 
3，数据整理模块，对于2里采集的数据，一旦采集后启动数据整理模块，根据事先设定好的主题（通常是对于公司或对应的行业和板块有一系列事先设好的问题）查看最新的信息（公告或新闻）有没有提供对这些问题的更新回答，如果有就要加到公司或行业和板块的对应主题的时间线上。
4，以上知识库系统要有自我进化能力，也要给用户足够的配置选择，包括公司列表，主题对应的问题清单，行业和板块等都可以动态进化。具体实现可以参考llm-wiki.md文档 ，也可以考虑知识库工具比如obsidian cli等等。
